submissions.decision-capacity-constrained-rebate-ele: WITH candidates(election_ids, pallets_used, rebate_cents) AS (SELECT source_id, pallets, rebate_cents FROM offer_evidence WHERE pallets <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT a.source_id || ',' || b.source_id, a.pallets + b.pallets, a.rebate_cents + b.rebate_cents FROM offer_evidence AS a JOIN offer_evidence AS b ON a.source_id COLLATE BINARY < b.source_id AND a.supplier_code <> b.supplier_code WHERE a.pallets + b.pallets <= 10) SELECT election_ids, pallets_used, rebate_cents FROM candidates ORDER BY rebate_cents DESC, pallets_used ASC, election_ids COLLATE BINARY ASC LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-capped-vendor-credit: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(MIN(affected_units * unit_credit_cents, item_cap_cents)) AS capped_sum FROM credit_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.order_id, MIN(o.order_cap_cents, COALESCE(t.capped_sum, 0)) AS payable_cents FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN line_totals AS t ON t.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id ASC
submissions.decision-catalogue-freeze-correction-tra: SELECT f.edition_code, n.adoption_day, n.source_id FROM edition_freeze AS f JOIN editorial_notice AS n ON n.standard_code = f.standard_code AND n.issue_day <= f.freeze_day WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM editorial_notice AS correction WHERE correction.replaces_id = n.source_id AND correction.issue_day <= f.freeze_day) ORDER BY f.edition_code ASC
submissions.decision-chance-adjusted-transcription-a: WITH counts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(left_reading = right_reading) AS matches, SUM(left_reading = 'A') AS left_a, SUM(right_reading = 'A') AS right_a FROM transcriptions), chance AS (SELECT n, matches, left_a * right_a + (n - left_a) * (n - right_a) AS expected FROM counts), fraction AS (SELECT (matches * n - expected) * 1000000 AS numerator, n * n - expected AS denominator FROM chance) SELECT (numerator + CASE WHEN numerator < 0 THEN -(denominator / 2) ELSE denominator / 2 END) / denominator AS kappa_ppm FROM fraction
